about_the_game:
The gods are dead, leaving only their authority and curses to flow through the world. You will become the new God of War, ending this eternal cycle and becoming humanity's savior. Let us forge a new legend of the God of War in this challenging RPG game.

Game Features

  • Talent System
    Players can learn talents in three developmental directions, each corresponding to different aspects of the game.
    To help players quickly adapt to the current environment, multiple talent pages are thoughtfully designed, allowing players to switch talent skills by toggling between pages.

  • Divine Abilities System
    The game currently features five major divine ability systems, each with its own unique divine skills. By combining these divine abilities, players can form their own distinctive strategies.

  • Spirit System
    Players can activate their spirit by devouring equipment of different levels.
    When a full set of equipment of a certain level is collected, the corresponding spirit attributes will be activated.

  • Artifact System
    In the game, players will acquire artifacts such as the Primordial Pearl and the Xuanyuan Sword. Enhancing the level of these artifacts will significantly boost the player's combat power.

Gameplay

  • Endless Challenge
    Enter the challenge dungeon, where players will face levels with varying difficulties and conditions.
    Upon meeting the conditions of the current level, players can proceed to the next.
    In the early stages, players only need to achieve a total damage output within a specified time to complete the level. Later, higher and even combined conditions await players to challenge.
